```yaml
name: Deploy docs on main branch commits

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions: {}  # Least privilege – no default permissions

jobs:
  paths-filter:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      docs: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.docs }}
    steps:
      - name: Detect changes in docs
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v2
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            docs:
              - 'docs/**'

  trigger-website-deploy:
    needs: paths-filter
    if: needs.paths-filter.outputs.docs == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {}  # No repo permissions required for this job
    steps:
      - name: Trigger Vercel deploy hook
        run: |
          curl -X POST ${{ secrets.WEBSITE_VERCEL_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL }}
        env:
          WEBSITE_VERCEL_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.WEBSITE_VERCEL_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL }}
```
